label: Finite models for the CONTINGENT_1 node and its modal-collapse refutations
paraphrase: Formal controls on hand-written Bool/Unit carriers: (1) nonvacuity: on a two-world universal frame with one being at both worlds and one only at world false, the node, the T, B and 5 schemas, the Cogito population node and the grounding premise hold, and every refutation conclusion holds; (2) omissions: on a one-world frame (node omitted) all schemas hold and every rival holds; on the step frame (every world accesses only true) the node holds while the T schema fails and collapse holds at every accessible world, and the B schema fails and collapse holds at some accessible world; on the reflexive frame false-le-true the node and the T schema hold, the B and 5 schemas fail and collapse holds at an accessible world; (3) scope: concrete necessitarianism makes STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT true vacuously at every profile and world. No model is claimed to describe reality.
